title: Fixture expectation
description: What an interrogation of one golden artifact must conclude. Assertions are on structure - which constraints are cited at which severity - never on wording, because wording is model output and asserting on it would make every test brittle.

artifact.description: Filename of the golden artifact, in this directory.

against.description: The predecessor this artifact is judged against. A spec is judged against its intent, a plan against its spec.

must_cite_blocking.description: Every constraint listed must appear as a blocking finding. Empty means the artifact is sound.

allow_other_blocking.description: false means blocking findings must be exactly must_cite_blocking. A fixture that tolerates extra blockers cannot detect over-reporting, which is as damaging as under-reporting.
